svg.aria-label: Guztchian — Software Engineering at SJTU. O ever youthful, O ever weeping.
svg.title: Guztchian — Software Engineering at SJTU. O ever youthful, O ever weeping.
svg.text: Software Engineering student at Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
Wandering between technology and literature — describing the world with math,
reshaping it with code, and occasionally trying to understand it with words.

g.text: O ever youthful, O ever weeping.
